sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: railroad crossings, city, rural and interstate driving
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The first page reproduces the railroad signal statute with section letters and amendment years; the rules were restated in plain words and the statute history was not copied [A01].
The page also states mileage and crossing counts for the state's rail network; they were left out as descriptive context, not rules [A01].
The interstate page lists a toll road phone number and website; they were not reproduced because they are service details [A05].
The headlight and taillight standards appear at the start of the vehicle equipment chapter on the last page of this range; they were taught here because this is where they are printed [A06].
The example Blue Sign image shows placeholder digits; no number from the image was used.

corpus_stability.reason: The handbook prints a single revision date (Revised May 2025) on its back cover and states laws and fees are subject to change by the General Assembly; no sign of more than one revision per year in the selected pages.
